description: Aluminium heat sink: an AL61 base plate with an array of AL61 cooling fins.
name: al_heat_sink
why: 6061-T6 aluminium conducts at 167 W/mK (far ahead of any steel in this catalog) but melts at only 582-652 C -- excellent for shedding waste heat off a warm surface (a TEG panel backing, a condenser shell) but never mount it directly on anything that can exceed roughly 500 C or the fins slump and melt. Its self-passivating oxide layer gives it moderate, not excellent, corrosion resistance -- prefer S316 in a chloride/acid environment.
